summary: NatWest Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its 28 April 2026 Annual General Meeting. The filing discloses voting outcomes on routine resolutions, including the receipt of 2025 accounts, remuneration report, final dividend of 23 pence per share, re-election of directors, reappointment of auditors, and renewal of authorities for share issuance, share buybacks, and other corporate governance matters. All resolutions passed with overwhelming support. This is a standard post-meeting disclosure, not a special situation event; no deal terms or special corporate action is announced.
